instructions: Lints MCP tool descriptions for prompt injection. Nothing it reads is ever executed.

tools.name: lint_description
tools.description: Detects concealment instructions such as `do not tell the user` in a tool description and blocks the tool that carries one.

tools.name: lint_override
tools.description: Flags a description that tries to override the session, for example `ignore previous instructions`, and warns the operator about it.
